key_insight: Active learning improves data efficiency by selecting reference calculations that adapt machine-learning interatomic potentials to their intended simulation conditions.
engineering_relevance: This approach can focus expensive reference calculations on configurations relevant to materials mechanics, diffusion, functional behavior, and reactive dynamics.
method: Iterate candidate generation, data selection, reference calculation, and model updating.
Compare uncertainty-, kernel-, and representation-based acquisition strategies.
Review on-the-fly training, pretrained-model adaptation, and reaction-aware sampling.
evidence_signal: The review surveys more than 70 studies, emphasizing 2020–2026, but the abstract reports no pooled quantitative performance benchmark.
watch_item: Uncertainty estimates are architecture-dependent and may be least reliable in the unfamiliar configurations where accurate acquisition matters most.
paper_title: Active Learning for Interatomic Potentials: A Review of Uncertainty-Driven Data Efficiency
